player.description: A big, broad-chested American man in his late 30s with a deep, resonant baritone voice and a native General American accent, like a veteran police officer
player.emotion: loud and forceful, commanding from the chest, low and steady, controlled, no strain, no voice cracks
player.text: Get down on the ground, right now! Show me your hands! I said get down, do it now!
player.heard: Get down on the ground right now. Show me your hands. I said get down. Do it now.

attacker.description: A big American man in his 40s with a deep, gravelly, rough street voice
attacker.text: You hear me? You're dead! I'm gonna make you pay for this. Get over here, right now!

knife.description: A lean American man in his early 30s with a low, raspy, cold voice and a slight hiss on his s's
knife.emotion: cold, menacing, snarling through his teeth, getting louder
knife.text: You shouldn't have come down here. Nobody's gonna hear you. You're dead, you hear me? Dead!
knife.heard: You shouldn't have come down here. Nobody's gonna hear you. You're dead, you hear me? Dead.

burglar.description: A wiry American man in his late 20s with a scratchy, mid-low, clearly masculine voice and a chesty tone
burglar.emotion: scared and breathless, talking fast, but his voice stays low in his chest, no voice cracks
burglar.text: Whoa, whoa, okay, I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I didn't touch anything, I swear, just let me go, please!
burglar.heard: Whoa, okay. I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I didn't touch anything. I swear. Just let me go, please.

gunman.description: A stocky American man in his late 30s with a hard, clipped, harsh voice and a tough East Coast city accent
gunman.text: Don't move! Where's the money? Don't you look at me! Get down, now, or I swear I'll shoot you!
gunman.heard: Don't move! Where's the money? Don't you look at me! Get down now, or I swear I'll shoot you!

mike.description: A heavyset American man in his 50s with a low, husky, beer-soaked baritone voice
mike.emotion: drunk and slurring, friendly, fairly loud, a little startled
mike.text: Hey! Hey buddy, it's me, Mike, from next door! Whoa, easy, easy, it's just me. I think I got the wrong house again.
mike.heard: Hey. Hey, buddy. It's me, Mike, from next door. Whoa, easy, easy. It's just me. I think I got the wrong house again.

sal_20261003-0203.description: A heavyset American man in his late 40s with a rough, working-class baritone voice
sal_20261003-0203.emotion: gruff and casual, a little impatient, speaking up to be heard through a door
sal_20261003-0203.text: Ricky? It's Sal. Open up, it's freezing out here. Come on, man, I brought you some smokes. Open the door.
sal_20261003-0203.heard: Ricky, it's Sal. Open up, it's freezing out here. Come on, man, I brought you some smokes. Open the door.

ricky.description: A nervous American man in his early 40s with a low, raspy smoker's baritone voice
ricky.emotion: anxious but low in the chest, quiet and tense, no voice cracks
ricky.text: Who's that? Nobody's supposed to know I'm here. Okay, okay, I'm down. I'm staying down. Just get me to Monday.

deputy.emotion: tired and calm, flat and matter-of-fact, steady, low

operator.description: An American man in his 40s with a quiet, flat, very low voice, an ex-military professional
operator.emotion: quiet, clipped and cold, no emotion, very low and controlled
operator.text: Contact front. Two moving, stay on my left. Find the witness. Check every room. Reloading. Covering. Go.
